name: chart
title: Chart
description: Line, bar, area, doughnut and other charts drawn on a <canvas>, styled with the page's fonts and colors.

attributes.name: data-chart
attributes.description: Draws a chart on the canvas.

attributes.name: data-chart-type
attributes.description: Chart.js chart type: line (default), bar, doughnut, pie, radar, bubble, …

attributes.name: data-chart-data
attributes.description: JSON for Chart.js's data option: labels and datasets.

attributes.name: data-chart-options
attributes.description: JSON for Chart.js's options, e.g. scales and interaction.

notes: Chart.js resizes the chart to its container. Wrap the canvas in an element with position: relative and a fixed height.

The first chart on the page sets Chart.js defaults from the body's computed styles: text color, font, background and border color. Charts drawn before a color scheme change keep the old colors until the page reloads.
Give the canvas role="img" and an aria-label that describes the data.
